test_name: Stem attachment keeps each note's own key across a mid-score key change
description: Audit 2026-11-02 M1. The score's config attaches stems at the notehead's side (default-side) while F# is out of the key and at its centre (center-stem) once F# is in it. Measure 1 (C major) and measure 2 (G major) hold the same notes: G4 quarter, A4 quarter, G4 half, all stems up. cnb:stem-attachment runs at layout time, when the config cache holds the last key of the score; it used to look the attachment up there, so measure 1 took G major's centred stems. The notehead engraver now captures the attachment on each notehead at acknowledge time. An up-stem attached at the side has its right edge on the notehead's right edge; a centred stem has its centre on the notehead's centre.

assertions._comment: === SECTION 1: MEASURE 1 (C MAJOR) KEEPS SIDE-ATTACHED STEMS ===

assertions.description: C major, G4 quarter: stem's right edge on the notehead's right edge
C major, A4 quarter: stem's right edge on the notehead's right edge
C major, G4 half: stem's right edge on the (doubled) notehead's right edge

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: MEASURE 2 (G MAJOR) TAKES CENTRED STEMS ===

assertions.description: G major, G4 quarter: stem centred on the notehead
G major, A4 quarter: stem centred on the notehead
G major, G4 half: stem centred on the (doubled) notehead

assertions._comment: === SECTION 3: THE SAME NOTE DIFFERS ONLY BY KEY ===

assertions.description: Measure-1 and measure-2 G4 quarter stems sit at different offsets from their noteheads
